Name: Nodi kantha throw
Short description: Nodi kantha throw: indigo and green hand-stitched river waves on four layers of recycled cotton. 50 × 70 in, made in Bangladesh.
Description: Nodi means river. Rows of indigo and green stitches run across the throw like slow water, with a turmeric lotus at the centre. Made from four layers of pre-loved cotton saris, so the reverse side shows a second pattern.

Name: Shapla kantha throw
Short description: Shapla kantha throw with a hand-stitched rose water lily and indigo border. Lightweight 3-layer cotton, 50 × 70 in.
Description: The shapla, a water lily, is the national flower of Bangladesh. Here it opens in rose thread at the centre of the throw, framed by indigo borders. Lighter than our four-layer throws, good for warmer months.

Name: Mati kantha throw
Short description: Mati kantha throw in earth brown and turmeric hand stitching. Four layers of recycled cotton, 50 × 70 in.
Description: Mati means earth. Brown and turmeric stitches build up like ploughed rows, with small green seed shapes scattered between them.

Name: Akash kantha throw
Description: Our largest throw, sized for a queen bed. Akash means sky: pale blue running stitch over deep indigo, worked by two stitchers sitting on either side of the cloth.

Name: Nodi kantha throw
Short description: Lap-size Nodi kantha throw with indigo and green river stitching. 40 × 55 in, three layers of recycled cotton.
Description: The Nodi pattern in a lap size, for an armchair or a child's bed. Same river rows, three layers instead of four.

Name: Jonaki kantha throw
Short description: Jonaki kantha throw: turmeric firefly stars hand-stitched on indigo cotton. 4 layers, 50 × 70 in.
Description: Jonaki means firefly. Hundreds of small turmeric stars are stitched over a dark indigo ground, each one finished with a single rose knot.

Name: Kolka jamdani scarf
Short description: Kolka jamdani scarf with paisley motifs woven into sheer indigo cotton. 24 × 72 in, handwoven in Bangladesh.
Description: The kolka, a curved paisley shape, is woven straight into sheer indigo cotton. Light enough to wear in summer and warm enough for an office.

Name: Tara jamdani scarf
Short description: Tara jamdani scarf: white star grid woven on turmeric cotton with rose borders. Handwoven, 24 × 72 in.
Description: Tara means star. A grid of small white stars is woven on a turmeric ground, with a rose border at each end.

Name: Panna jamdani scarf
Description: Panna is emerald. A cotton and silk blend gives this green scarf a slight shine, with white diamond motifs woven along its length.

Name: Dhaka grid jamdani scarf
Short description: Dhaka grid jamdani scarf with a white woven grid on indigo cotton. Classic handwoven scarf, 22 × 70 in.
Description: A simple white grid on indigo, the pattern our weavers learn first. Our most-worn scarf.

Name: Golap jamdani scarf
Short description: Golap jamdani scarf with woven white flowers on rose-pink cotton. Handwoven in Bangladesh, 24 × 72 in.
Description: Golap means rose. Small woven flowers climb diagonally across a rose-pink ground.

Name: Shapla cushion cover
Short description: Shapla kantha cushion cover with a hand-stitched rose water lily. Fits 18 × 18 in inserts, hidden zip.
Description: The Shapla water lily from our throw, sized for a cushion. Hidden zip, insert not included.

Name: Nodi cushion cover
Description: River rows in indigo and green. Pairs with the Nodi throw.

Name: Jonaki cushion cover
Short description: Jonaki kantha cushion cover: turmeric firefly stitching on indigo cotton. Fits 20 × 20 in inserts.
Description: Turmeric fireflies on indigo, in a larger 20 inch size.

Name: Mati cushion cover
Short description: Mati kantha cushion cover in brown and turmeric hand stitching. 18 × 18 in, hidden zip.
Description: Earth-brown furrows with green seeds. Warm next to wood and leather.

Name: Akash lumbar cushion cover
Short description: Akash lumbar cushion cover: sky-blue kantha stitching on indigo. 12 × 20 in, hidden zip.
Description: A long lumbar cover with sky-blue stitching on indigo.

Name: Border kantha table runner
Short description: Kantha table runner with hand-stitched indigo and turmeric borders. Washable cotton, 14 × 72 in.
Description: Plain cotton with a deep stitched border at each end, so plates and serving dishes have a quiet background.

Name: Leaf kantha table runner
Short description: Leaf kantha table runner with a hand-stitched green vine. Long 14 × 90 in cotton runner for dining tables.
Description: A long runner for a full dining table, with a vine of green leaves stitched along its length.

Name: Kantha napkins, set of 4
Short description: Set of 4 kantha napkins, each with a different hand-stitched corner flower. Cotton, 18 × 18 in.
Description: Four napkins, each with a different stitched corner flower. Mix them across the table.

Name: Jamdani placemats, set of 2
Short description: Set of 2 jamdani placemats with a woven white grid on indigo cotton. 13 × 19 in each.
Description: Woven jamdani grid placemats, a thicker version of our Dhaka grid scarf cloth.

Name: Patchwork kantha tote
Short description: Patchwork kantha tote made from hand-stitched throw offcuts. Lined cotton bag with inside pocket, every one unique.
Description: Each tote is pieced from offcuts left over from our throws, so no two are the same. Lined, with an inside pocket.

Name: Indigo market tote
Short description: Indigo market tote quilted with white kantha running stitch. Wide flat-bottomed cotton grocery bag.
Description: A wide, flat-bottomed bag for groceries, quilted in white running stitch on indigo.

Name: Jonaki zip tote
Description: The firefly pattern on a tote with a zip top, for a laptop or library books.

Name: Mini kantha pouch
Short description: Mini kantha zip pouch from hand-stitched offcuts. 6 × 9 in, for pens, cables or make-up.
Description: A small zip pouch for pens, cables or make-up. Made from the smallest offcuts.
